title: Phenotyping 3D Coral Models in MeshLab
author: Wyatt C Million
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgbpjsmn

steps.title: Import 3D Model
steps.instruction: Open the 3D model file (recommended format: Wavefront .obj for color inclusion) in MeshLab.

substeps.instruction: Go to File > Import mesh
Select the file and open

steps.title: Measure Scaling Markers
steps.instruction: Measure 3 separate radii on the scaling markers (e.g., 12 bit, 2mm Metashape markers) from the center of the inner black circle to the outside edge of the outer black ring.

substeps.instruction: Select the Measuring Tool
Click once to set the start point, move the mouse, and click again to set the end point
Press ESC to make another measurement or to rotate/zoom the model

steps.title: Calculate Scale Factor
steps.instruction: Determine the scale factor using the actual measure of the scaling object and the average of the 3D measurements.

substeps.instruction: Average the replicate 3D measures of the scaling object
Calculate scale factor: (actual measure of scaling object) / (average of replicate 3D measures of scaling object)
Example for test model: 0.6 cm / (average of radii) = scale factor

steps.title: Apply Scale Factor
steps.instruction: Scale the model to real-life dimensions using the calculated scale factor.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Filters > Normals, Curvatures, and Orientation > Transform: Scale, Normalize
Enter the scale factor into the X Axis box
Ensure 'Uniform Scaling', 'Freeze Matrix', and 'Apply to All Visible Layers' are checked
Click 'Apply'
Verify the model size by remeasuring the scaling object

steps.title: Fill Coral Holes for Surface Area
steps.instruction: Fill holes in the coral mesh to approximate missing surface area before measuring.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Filters > Remeshing, Simplification, and Reconstruction > Close Holes
Set 'Max size to be closed' in increments of 50 until holes are closed
Uncheck all boxes below 'Max size to be closed' and click apply

steps.title: Measure Mesh Surface Area
steps.instruction: Calculate the surface area of the mesh in cm².

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Filters > Quality Measure and Computations > Compute Geometric Measures
Locate the surface area measurement in the software output panel (bottom right)

steps.title: Create Watertight Mesh for Volume
steps.instruction: Close the mesh (typically the bottom where coral meets substrate) to make it watertight for volume calculation.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Filters > Remeshing, Simplification, and Reconstruction > Close Holes
Set 'Max size to be closed' large enough to encompass the hole (usually >3000)
Uncheck all boxes below and click apply

steps.title: Repair Non-Manifold Geometry
steps.instruction: If a non-manifold edges/vertices error occurs, remove the problematic geometry.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Filters > Cleaning and Repair > Select non Manifold edges or Select non Manifold vertices
Use the Delete Selected Area tool to remove selected edges/vertices

steps.title: Measure Linear Extension
steps.instruction: Measure the length of all coral branches.

substeps.instruction: For the main axial branch: measure from the tip to the base created in the watertight step
For secondary branches: measure from the tip to the midpoint of the intersection where the branch joins the main branch

steps.title: Measure Coral Volume
steps.instruction: Calculate the volume of the closed mesh in cm³.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Filters > Quality Measure and Computations > Compute Geometric Measures
Locate the volume measurement in the software output panel

steps.title: Generate Convex Hull
steps.instruction: Create a convex hull mesh overlayed over the most extreme points of the model.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Filters > Remeshing, Simplification, and Reconstruction > Convex Hull
Check 'Re-orient all faces coherently' and click apply

steps.title: Measure Convex Hull Volume
steps.instruction: Calculate the volume of the convex hull.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Filters > Quality Measure and Computations > Compute Geometric Measures
Locate the volume in the software output box
If the volume is negative, take the absolute value

steps.title: Calculate Interstitial Space Volume
steps.instruction: Determine the volume of the interstitial space between branches.

substeps.instruction: Subtract the volume of the coral from the volume of the convex hull
